in_sanskrit.name: अनुरोध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who fulfills the desires or wishes of others. A request, demand, or appeal.

in_hindi.name: अनुरोध
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनुरूप (similar, conformable), अनुरक्त (dear, beloved), अनुरोधी (requester, desirer)

in_marathi.name: Anurodh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, desire, request
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anurodh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu-roopa Dha: a desire or wish that takes the form of a request. The root 'anu' means 'with', and 'roopa' means 'form'. This name symbolizes the power of a sincere request and the fulfillment of desires.

in_bengali.name: Anurodh

The root 'anu' means 'with', and 'roopa' means 'form'. This name symbolizes the power of a sincere request and the fulfillment of desires.
